name: Prefix Sharing & KV Cache Reuse Systems
core_idea: Avoid recomputing KV caches for shared or recurring context (system prompts, retrieved documents, in-context examples) by precomputing, storing, and reusing per-segment KV caches across queries. KVLink enables reuse of independently encoded per-document caches via positional re-encoding (store without RoPE, re-apply global rotations at concat) and trainable link tokens that restore cross-document attention, combined with chunked anchor-token compression. LMCache is the systems substrate: a unified KV caching layer between inference engines (vLLM/SGLang) and heterogeneous storage (GPU/CPU/remote) with chunk-level transfer, async layer-wise loading, and adaptive load-vs-prefill decisions. The route targets the RAG/multi-query and disaggregated-serving settings and is orthogonal to (composable with) compression/eviction.
